clips.title: The story
paras: Moonspray carries travelers between Darkshore and Teldrassil. The Alliance transport sails across the waters separating mainland Kalimdor from the great World Tree.

Moonspray sails between Auberdine and Rut'theran Village. Across the Veiled Sea, the vessel carries adventurers, couriers, and provisions between Darkshore's coast and the night elf sanctuary at Teldrassil's crown.
